newsitem.title: UK: Bell's launches whisky campaign in soccer stadium.
newsitem.headline: Bell's launches whisky campaign in soccer stadium.

text.p: Bell's whisky said it would launch a four million pound ($6.5 million) advertising campaign for its eight-year-old Scotch whisky on Monday evening that is designed to maintain its leading market share in Britain.

Bell's, owned by the United Distillers unit of Guinness Plc, said it would launch the advert in front of 50,000 soccer fans. The advert, which portrays the whisky as "uisge beatha" -- Gaelic for "the Water of Life" -- will be shown on a giant screen before the kick-off of the Rangers versus Hearts game at Ibrox Stadium in Glasgow.
The commercial will be broadcast on television from September and supplemented by a packaging and label redesign.

"The new packaging will take Bell's into the next Millennium with a more contemporary, distinctive version of the existing classic label," Jonathan Turner, consumer marketing manager for Bell's, said in a statement. The new curved label will be unveiled in October.
Bell's in 1996 had retail sales of 290 million pounds.
